proc_p: Alcove units take four to six weeks to make once you approve the design.
steps: We measure both alcoves and note the skirting, sockets and any radiator.
You see the cupboards and shelving in 3D, with a quote that lists each unit.
Each unit is made to its own alcove in our workshop, as the two sides are rarely the same.
We scribe the edges tight to the wall and ceiling, backed by our 12-month guarantee.
book_p: Send a photo of the alcoves on WhatsApp or book a visit. We’ll measure both sides and send a 3D design with an itemised quote.
